entities.name: ProSe Key Management Function Address
entities.description: This IE is included by the UE acting as ProSe UE-to-network relay to provide the network with the address of the ProSe Key Management Function associated with remote UEs connected to or disconnected from the relay.

entities.name: UE acting as ProSe UE-to-network relay
entities.description: A UE that functions as a ProSe UE-to-network relay, connecting remote UEs to the network.

entities.name: ProSe Key Management Function
entities.description: The function responsible for key management in ProSe communications, associated with remote UEs connected to or disconnected from the ProSe UE-to-network relay.

entities.name: Remote UE
entities.description: A UE that is connected to or disconnected from the ProSe UE-to-network relay.

relations.description: The UE acting as ProSe UE-to-network relay includes the ProSe Key Management Function Address IE in the message.
The IE provides the address of the ProSe Key Management Function.
The ProSe Key Management Function is associated with remote UEs connected to or disconnected from the ProSe UE-to-network relay.
